meta.title: A planner cannot clone
gaps: the plan has the vendor send POST /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/create_clone, but the supplier app may not call POST /event_groups/:id/create_clone (it is not on agribid_website's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
The planner role and create permission are not expressible; the closest available case uses the invited vendor.
warnings: error code 455 is not in en-IN.yml (or the backend checkout is missing) — the message cannot be checked

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the event groups create clone request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.

expected.message: You are not authorized to perform this action
